Layout-decided scrollbars (CSS Overflow 3 section 3): only complete layout publishes overflow:auto bar decisions; intrinsic queries read the current gutter because their overflow can be provisional or incomplete. A box is laid out with its guessed bars and repeats when its completed scrollable overflow (a scroll range proxy excluded) asks for others, retaining newly appeared bars without an iteration cap (Blink AddScrollbarFreeze). The viewport publishes its gutter first; out-of-flow boxes built for another root gutter resolve their insets against the decided one; a parent records the decided scrollbar size. Descendant gutter changes invalidate intrinsic ancestor measurements and repeat their size selection with transaction-frozen bars; empty grid and lane tracks contribute their in-flow overflow area. An optional typed observer reports dependency retries and their constraints without constructing events when disabled.
